prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A minimalist, studio-lit product display set against a solid, vibrant yellow background. In the foreground, large, three-dimensional letters spelling out "SALE" are crafted from textured cardboard, standing upright and casting soft shadows. To the right of the letters, three rolls of white toilet paper are neatly stacked in a pyramid formation, their clean, crisp edges contrasting with the matte cardboard. In front of the toilet paper, a pair of white socks with light gray toes and heels are laid flat, side by side, their fabric texture clearly visible. The composition is balanced and uncluttered, with ample negative space, evoking a playful yet utilitarian mood. The color palette is dominated by warm yellows and neutral whites and browns, with even, diffused lighting that eliminates harsh shadows and highlights the tactile qualities of each object. The overall style is modern and graphic, reminiscent of commercial advertising photography, with a straightforward, eye-catching arrangement and a sense of cheerful simplicity.
